AC Syndicate Jack The Ripper DLC “Lost In The City” Instant Fail Glitch - Console Fix
I know this game is over 10 years old at this point but I’ve been playing through the all the AC games and ran into this glitch for the side mission “Lost In The City” where upon starting the mission you instantly fail saying you failed to locate the prostitute. 

There was nothing I could find anywhere online for a console solution, so I’m just putting this out here so when someone else runs into it and starts googling it they can find this. 

But if this happens to you. 

-Fully close the game
-Hard Restart Your Console (shut down, and unplug for 2 minutes)
-Load Back in the game
-Fast Travel to a different location and then actually run to the mission marker

This worked for me, you might get away with just fast traveling and running back. But I covered all the bases.
